name: Whiskervale Forerunner
description: Valiant -- Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with mana value 3 or less from among them. You may put it onto the battlefield if it's your turn. If you don't put it onto the battlefield, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
couldNotDerive: The entire PeekAndReveal/ChooseCard effect chain -- untranslated, correctly absent rather than shown wrong.
notes: The trigger condition itself (Valiant/once_per_turn, becomestarget) reconstructed correctly. The effect is a genuinely complex chain (DB$ PeekAndReveal -> DB$ ChooseCard -> two conditionally-gated DB$ ChangeZone branches -> DB$ ChangeZoneAll for the random-order bottoming) with no handler support at any step (PeekAndReveal, ChooseCard both unmapped; the ConditionPlayerTurn$/ConditionPresent$+ConditionCompare$-gated branches would need the same design work as the general Condition class even if the base effects were implemented). Same ValidSource$YouCtrl gap as Flowerfoot Swordmaster/Mouse Trapper/Nettle Guard on top. Not attempted this round -- a genuinely large, multi-part effect, appropriately left for a dedicated pass rather than a quick fix.
